title: Six-month growth statement & manager briefing
content:
Quick purpose: prep doc for 1:1 with my manager (week of 2026-03-09). Capture succinct growth narrative, evidence to support promotion trajectory, short-term priorities, and clear asks. Keep this lightweight — use as crib notes during conversation.

Top-line growth narrative (60s):
- Over the last 12 months I shifted focus from transactional recruiting ops to scalable programs: redesigned new-hire onboarding flow, introduced a quarterly hiring forecast, and led two cross-functional pilots to reduce time-to-productivity. As a result we improved onboarding NPS from ~6.8 to 7.9 (pilot teams) and decreased time-to-first-customer-task from 18 -> 12 days for core infra hires.
- Development focus now: program-level ownership (end-to-end), influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and improving people analytics instrumentation. I want to grow toward a senior program lead role that owns multi-quarter initiatives and mentors other ICs.

Evidence/examples (concise bullets):
- Onboarding redesign (Q2–Q4 2025): led research (12 interviews), defined new "Day-0 checklist" and paired automation with onboarding buddy program. Measured impact via NPS and task completion: NPS +1.1 for pilot teams, task completion 30% faster. Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/people-ops/onboarding-improvements/pull/432.
- Hiring forecast & capacity model (Q3 2025): created spreadsheet + playbook used by Eng managers for planning; reduced reactive requisition creation by ~40% in pilot org. Confluence: /company/people-ops/hiring-velocity-2026.
- Cross-functional pilot w/Eng + IR (Q4 2025): shortened candidate follow-up time using templated next-steps, resulting in offer acceptance improvement from 68% -> 75% for prioritized roles.
- Mentoring: 1:1s with two junior recruiters since Aug 2025; both show measurable growth in candidate ownership (owner of 3 searches end-to-end).

Impact metrics to call out in 1:1 (be crisp):
- Onboarding NPS (pilot teams): 6.8 -> 7.9 (Q3->Q4)
- Time-to-first-customer-task (infra hires): 18d -> 12d
- Reactive requisition creation (pilot org): down ~40%
- Offer acceptance (priority roles): 68% -> 75%

What I want next (concrete asks):
1) Stretch scope: transition to owning one cross-functional program end-to-end for 2026 H1 (example candidate: onboarding + hiring forecast integration for Dedicated team).
2) Mentorship bandwidth: permission to formalize a monthly peer-coaching slot (30m) and recruit one mentee from recruiting coordinator pool.
3) Exposure: shadow product/infra prioritization meeting monthly for 3 months to learn stakeholder tradeoff framing.
4) Calibration: clear rubric for what success looks like for "Senior Program Owner" (or next band). Request HR/manager to share benchmarks or past examples.

Potential objections I anticipate + short rebuttals:
- "We need you on urgent reqs" -> I will create a runbook + rotate coverage so program ownership doesn't stall critical searches.
- "Not enough measurable ROI yet" -> provide roadmap with built-in checkpoints (30/60/90) and measurable KPIs (time-to-productivity, NPS, requisition churn).

6-month priority plan (milestones, not a project plan):
- Mar: secure program sponsorship from Eng manager for Dedicated onboarding pilot; align success metrics. Set up biweekly sync.
- Apr: prototype onboarding + hiring forecast integration for one cohort (2 teams); instrument metrics pipeline (spreadsheet -> automated dashboard).
- May: run cohort, collect NPS, iterate playbook; begin mentoring program pilot.
- Jun: prepare mid-year brief: present outcomes to People leadership and request formal role expansion if metrics meet thresholds.

Manager prep notes (questions to ask during 1:1):
- Which measurable outcomes would make you comfortable supporting my move to program ownership? (ask for two quick examples)
- Are there stakeholders you recommend I build credibility with first for the Dedicated pilot? (names/teams)
- What bandwidth can you commit to shadowing exposures / prep time? (30m/month? review the brief?)
- Are there past hires/promoted ICs you think I should chat with to understand next-level expectations?

Risks & mitigations (quick):
- Risk: program stretches my bandwidth and hiring coverage slips. Mitigation: detailed runbook, delegate reactive searches to rotational pool.
- Risk: metrics noisy because small cohort. Mitigation: pair with qualitative signals (manager testimonials, new-hire anecdotes) and extend pilot to one more cohort if variance high.

Open items I need to do before the meeting (todo):
- Pull up NPS raw data for pilot teams + 3 anonymized comments (by 2026-03-07).
- Save one-page deck (3 slides): situation, actions, measurable outcomes + asks (by 2026-03-08).
- Draft two-sentence sponsorship ask for Eng manager (to share in sync) (by 2026-03-09).

Quick script (elevator):
"Over the past year I moved from operational recruiting into program-level work — shipping an onboarding redesign and a hiring forecast that reduced reactive work. I want to scale that impact by owning a cross-functional program in H1: measurable goal is to cut new-hire time-to-productivity by 25% for Dedicated hires while keeping requisition coverage steady. I need your sponsorship and a small allocation of shadowing time to make this a reliable, repeatable program."

Learning targets & resources (for next 6 months):
- framing program ROI for execs: read 3 short articles + two internal case studies (links in linked_artifacts).
- basics of product prioritization: find one meeting to observe and one book chapter (scheduling note).
- data viz for dashboards: 2-hour async workshop with analytics team (request).

Notes-to-self (short):
- Keep evidence compact: three numbers + one story.
- When asked about tradeoffs, lead with impacts (latency of hiring vs quality).
- Use "pilot" language to reduce perceived risk.

After-meeting checklist:
- Capture commitments (who will do what, timeline) and add to Confluence.
- If sponsorship granted, open PEOPLE-EPIC draft and add stakeholders.

Misc scratch:
- Possible advocates: Jordan (hiring forecast), Priya (onboarding NPS champion), Theo (infra manager who participated in pilot).
- Stretch project idea: connect onboarding playbook to role-based learning paths (first 90 days map).

End of doc.

(Version: personal scratchpad v0.9 — keep informal.)
